name: What should I do immediately after my home experiences interior storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my home experiences interior storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after interior storm damage, prioritize safety by checking for hazards like downed power lines or gas leaks. If safe, take photos or videos of the damage for insurance purposes. Prevent further damage by turning off water if there's a burst pipe, or by using buckets to catch leaks. Avoid entering structurally compromised areas. Then, contact City Dweller, LLC for emergency assessment and temporary repairs, and notify your insurance company. Do not attempt major repairs yourself if it poses a risk.
acceptedAnswer.description: After interior storm damage, prioritize safety, document damage with photos, prevent further issues if safe, then contact City Dweller, LLC and your insurance company.
